title: Research with a gate
learning_outcome: Record an experiment hypothesis, metric, and proposed next test without automatic promotion.
exercise: Write one hypothesis and a proposal packet from synthetic results.

scenes.narration_exact: “Morgan opens Harbor's paper planning folder on Friday. The Session Option Brief is still held because no one has confirmed staffing. scenes.narration_exact: “Chapter Twenty-Three separates five states: propose, not run, gate, trace, then approve or discard. For this classroom case, the proposed question is narrow: would a brief that puts staffing evidence first help Morgan identify a hold faster? The hypothesis needs a comparison and a metric. We could compare two invented brief layouts in a paper exercise. We cannot claim one works better because it looks cleaner to us. The `not_run` state records exactly what is missing.”

scenes.narration_exact: “Morgan owns the review of the proposal because Morgan owns this planning decision. A real experiment would need a fresh, scoped approval and an appropriate participant and privacy plan. This lesson grants none of that. In the paper scenario, Morgan can reject the idea, ask for a clearer baseline, or authorize a later bounded test. The agent cannot turn a promising hypothesis into durable memory. A memory proposal would need its own source, scope, expiry, and human decision.”

scenes.narration_exact: “Write a `not_run` reason that another person can act on: `No agreed comparison set or reviewer protocol; staffing hold remains unresolved.` Then add the next safe step: Morgan reviews whether the question is worth testing at all. If Morgan says no, keep the rejection and its reason. If Morgan says yes, define the test before anyone runs it. Either path teaches Harbor something about its priorities. A silent queue of ideas teaches almost nothing.”
audience_copy: Hold reason + owner + next safe step.

scenes.narration_exact: “Draft one AutoResearch Proposal using invented facts. Name the question, hypothesis, comparison, current baseline, primary metric and guardrail, expected direction, risk, touched surface, rollback, owner, approval question, and next metric gate. Mark the result `not_run`. Write the reason in plain language and the action Morgan may take after review. Keep the staffing and spend holds visible. Do not run a provider, contact anyone, change a setting, or promote a finding.”
scenes.on_screen_copy_exact: Exercise card below; 3:20 quiet writing timer with optional pause.
scenes.exercise_prompt_exact: Write an `AutoResearch Proposal` for one improvement to your invented workflow. Include title, question, hypothesis, comparison, expected impact, baseline, primary and guardrail metrics, test configuration, touched surface, risk, rollback, promotion recommendation, named approval question, next metric gate, `result_status: not_run`, and an actionable hold reason. The approval question must authorize only a later scoped research action, never a production change.
